body:
For a line that updates in place, use `rich.live.Live` (or `Progress` for a progress indicator). See https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst

`rich.print` renders text through Rich, which strips carriage-return control characters; flushing writes output immediately but does not enable cursor movement. For usage questions, please ask in Discussions: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
